scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the model, equilibrium derivation, printed reproduction number, and subthreshold global-stability claims. Exact symbolic replay verifies the threshold, equilibrium equation, witness, and local spectra. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns the deterministic SIR system exactly as printed. It gives a sharp subthreshold two-equilibrium condition and an exact bistable witness, but not a complete global phase portrait.

title: An exact backward-bistability counterexample in the convex-incidence SIR model
